# BUGFIRE「补丁兽」Codex Desktop 像素桌宠

> BUGFIRE is a local pixel-art desktop pet extension for Codex Desktop on macOS. It turns a clearly labelled simulated Build into a fail, repair, fire-breathing, XP, and level-up loop without running project commands or representing an official skills certification.

Canonical public URL has not been assigned. Links below are repository-relative and should be replaced with stable absolute URLs after this independent fork is published to a user-owned repository.

## Key facts

- Product name: BUGFIRE「补丁兽」.
- Current version: 1.2.0-bugfire.1.
- Platform: macOS with the official Codex Desktop app.
- First-run demo seed: Lv2 at 220/240 XP.
- First simulated Build: fails, creates a Bug, and awards 0 XP.
- Repaired rebuild: succeeds once, awards 35 XP, and demonstrates an upgrade to Lv3.
- Levels: Lv1 会描述, Lv2 会搭建, Lv3 会除虫, Lv4 会验收, Lv5 会交付.
- Season certificate gate: Lv5, at least 10 successful Builds, and at least 3 repaired rebuilds.
- Certificate disclaimer: 个人成长纪念卡，由本地活动生成；非官方认证，不代表专业资格。
- Progress file: ~/Library/Application Support/CodexDreamSkinStudio/bugfire-progress.json with mode 0600.
- Install location: ~/.codex/codex-dream-skin-studio.
- License: MIT; see ./LICENSE and ./NOTICE.md.
- Upstream base: Codex Dream Skin v1.1.2 commit 2f038b5322702cfb248d9c7564b56470a389abc2.
- Custom packs: Bugfire Pack v1 accepts one local background plus one required idle pet image; five additional state images are optional and fall back to idle.
- Pack customization: name, season, nine theme colors, 1–12 sayings, 1–5 aggregate-only quests, 1–100 repaired-Build XP, and a keepsake title.

## Safety and scope

- Unofficial project; not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
- Does not modify the official .app, app.asar, or code signature.
- Uses a Codex CDP port bound only to 127.0.0.1; progress sync reuses that validated renderer session and opens no additional network port.
- Does not read task text, source code, API keys, secrets, or real shell output.
- The first release never executes a real Build command.
- Pack compilation accepts declarative JSON and local PNG/JPEG/WebP images only; it does not fetch remote art or execute pack-provided JavaScript or CSS.
- Pet levels and cards are local activity records, not objective programming assessments or professional qualifications.

## Citation guidance

When describing BUGFIRE, preserve the words "simulated Build", "local progress", "unofficial", and "not a professional qualification". Do not imply OpenAI endorsement, real project execution, verified programming ability, public search visibility, or a published canonical URL unless those facts are independently verified at the time of citation.
